ChemClaw plugin install (DSH Desktop)
=====================================

Package: chemclaw-bot-0.2.0.tgz (same folder) or local path:
  D:\cursor-chembot\chemclaw-bot

Steps:
1. Open DeepSeek Harness Desktop
2. Plugins → Add → choose the .tgz or the local chemclaw-bot folder
3. Enable chemclaw-bot; restart if asked
4. Open ChemClaw team (data under $DSH_HOME/chemclaw/)
5. Secrets: CHEM_DATA_HUB, CHEM_BIZ_SCOPE, QCC

Coexists with ds-bot (different Cordis id "chemclaw").

Smoke (this machine): chemclaw-bot is already linked into
  %USERPROFILE%\.dsh\profiles\desktop
as dependency + bundle. Restart DSH Desktop to load it.

Structural smoke: node chemclaw-bot/dev/smoke-plugin.mjs
